First public release of **Game Launcher for Steam**, a Stream Deck plugin that fills your whole deck with your Steam games.

### Install
1. Download `tools.quin.steamlibrary.streamDeckPlugin` below and double-click it (Stream Deck 7.1+ on Windows).
2. Drag **Open Game Launcher** onto any key and press it.
3. Allow Stream Deck to install the included profile.

### Features
- One key opens an auto-filled game grid (profiles for Stream Deck, Mini and XL)
- Favorites, Installed, Recently played or All
- Steam Favorites or any of your own collections
- Finds games on every library drive
- Not-installed favorites shown in grey; press to install
- Returns to your previous profile after launching (optional)

No Steam login or API key needed. [Privacy policy](https://quin.tools/game-launcher/privacy/)
